q: In the broadcast channel (one sender, multiple receivers), the capacity region for a degraded broadcast channel is achieved by:
opts: Superposition coding (weaker user gets a coarse code, stronger user decodes and cancels)
Using a single codebook for all users
exp: Superposition coding (Cover 1972): encode message for weaker user at low rate using full power; encode message for stronger user as a refinement. The stronger receiver decodes and cancels the weak-user codeword, then decodes its own. This achieves the degraded broadcast channel capacity region.
